title: Hyrule Compendium tool manifest
description: Manifest for a tool listed in the Hyrule Compendium. Lives at the root of a tool repo as `hyrule.json`. Values here override metadata fetched from the GitHub API.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

name.description: Display name of the tool. Overrides the repo name.

command.description: The binary/command name. Used as the URL slug: /tools/<command>/. Must be unique across the Compendium.

tagline.description: One sentence, shown on the card. Overrides the repo description.

category.description: Which shelf of the Compendium this tool sits on.

status.description: Maturity. Drives the status badge on the card.

install.description: A single copy-pasteable install command. Rendered with a copy button.

docs.description: Absolute URL to external documentation, if the README is not the whole story.
